sources.entry: SFTPGo | Full-featured SFTP, FTP/S, HTTP/S and WebDAV server

summary.one_liner: SFTPGo is an event-driven file transfer server supporting SFTP, HTTP/S, FTP/S and WebDAV across local, encrypted local, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob and remote SFTP storage backends.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SFTPGo as a configurable file transfer solution that serves files over SFTP, HTTP/S, FTP/S and WebDAV. Its storage backends listed are the local filesystem, an encrypted local filesystem, S3-compatible object storage, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, and other SFTP servers. It ships with WebAdmin and WebClient web UIs, according to the Community edition description. The README also describes a commercial Enterprise edition with extra features such as virtual folders, PGP, ICAP antivirus/DLP and IMAP ingestion, but these are not part of the open-source edition. Documentation is at docs.sftpgo.com. Translations are managed through Crowdin.
use_cases: Serve files to business partners over SFTP or FTP/S
Expose S3, GCS or Azure Blob storage through legacy file transfer protocols
Provide browser or WebDAV access to shared files
Manage per-user file transfer accounts on a server
Bridge local storage and cloud object storage for file exchange
notable: Supports SFTP, HTTP/S, FTP/S and WebDAV in one server
Multiple storage backends including S3, GCS, Azure Blob and remote SFTP servers
Includes WebAdmin and WebClient web interfaces in the Community edition
Open-core model with a separate commercial Enterprise edition
caveats: Some advanced features (virtual folders, PGP/ICAP scanning, IMAP ingestion, advanced SSO) are only in the commercial Enterprise edition
The WebAdmin/WebClient UI theme is proprietary and cannot be reused in derivative works without permission
keywords: legacy protocol access to cloud storage
